tm.「あたしは チコ スライムつむり。\n スライムつむりは おツムが かしこいの。: "I'm Chico, a Slime snail. Slime snails are smart. That's why I love riddles.
tm.「とっておきのなぞなぞを 考えてるから\n 思いついたら 声をかけるね。\n あ: "I'm thinking up a super special riddle, so talk to me when you've got it. Let's have a riddle battle.
tm.「お兄ちゃん 今 おヒマ？\n もし おヒマだったら\n あたしと なぞなぞ勝負: "Big brother, are you free now? If you are, want to have a riddle battle with me?
tm.「ふ～ん お兄ちゃん 忙しいのね。\n おヒマな時は 声をかけてよ。: "Hmm, you're busy, big brother. Talk to me when you're free.
tm.「わーい！ お兄ちゃん いいノリねー！\n それじゃあ さっそく なぞなぞでーす: "Yay! You're a good sport, big brother! Then here comes the riddle.
tm.「とーっても 切れ味の悪い\n なまくらな武器って なーんだ？: "What's a really dull weapon that can't cut a thing?
tm.「なぞなぞの答えが わかったら\n お兄ちゃんが装備して あたしに見せてね。: "When you know the answer, equip it and show me, big brother.
tm.「第１問は けっこう 難問だから\n 特別に ヒントをあげよう。\n それじゃあ: "Question one is pretty tough, so I'll give you a special hint. Here goes, big brother.
tm.「なまくらな武器ってことは 切れない武器。\n どうして切れない？ かけてる？\: "A dull weapon is one that can't cut. Why can't it cut? Is it chipped? Rusty? Or is it just... bored?
tm.「……おっとっと ヒントを出しすぎたね。\n なぞなぞの答えが わかったら\n: "...Oops, I gave too many hints. When you know the answer, equip it and show me, big brother.
tm.「あらら お兄ちゃん\n 問題の答えが わかったんだねー。\n うーん どれどれ: "Oh my, big brother, you know the answer. Hmm, let's see...
tm.「……だーいせーいかーい！\n お兄ちゃんが 装備してる武器は\n もしかしなく: "...Correct! The weapon you're wearing is, without a doubt, a Steel broadsword!
tm.「はがねのつるぎは 刃がねえ つるぎ。\n だから なまくら武器なんだー！\n: "A broadsword is a 'bored' sword. That's why it's dull! Amazing, you figured it out!
tm.「お兄ちゃんは なかなか できる人だね。\n でもね まだ勝負は 終わらない。\: "You're pretty good, big brother. But the battle isn't over. Try one more of my riddles.
tm.「今度のは 前より もっと難しいよ。\n それじゃあ さっそく なぞなぞでーす。: "This one is harder than the last. Here comes the riddle.
tm.「持ってると なんだか\n 負けない気持ちに なってくる。\n この武器 いった: "When you hold it, you feel like you'll never lose. What's this weapon?
tm.「さすがに この問題は\n お兄ちゃんでも 解けないんじゃない？\n ひとつだけ: "Even you probably can't solve this one, big brother. I'll give you one hint.
tm.「負けない気持ちに なったときに\n おもわず 言っちゃう言葉って なあに？\n: "What do you shout when you feel you won't lose? 'I won't lose'? 'Never lose'? Or maybe... 'Fend, sir!'?
tm.「……だーいせーいかーい！\n お兄ちゃんが 装備してる武器は\n もしかしなく: "...Correct! The weapon you're wearing is, without a doubt, a Fencer's rapier!
tm.「まけんしのレイピアを 持ってると\n 負けんしっ！ と気合いが入って\n なん: "Hold a Fencer's rapier and you think 'Fend, sir! I won't lose!' It fills you with a never-lose spirit!
tm.「……は～あ 自慢のなぞなぞを\n ２問も解かれちゃうなんて 思わなかったな。\: "Sigh... I never thought my proud riddles would both be solved. You're amazing, big brother.
tm.「今回は あたしの負けだよ。\n お兄ちゃんの 勝利をたたえて\n とっても い: "This time I lose. To praise your victory, I'll give you something really nice.
tm.「あたしも まだまだ 修行が足りないな。\n もっと もっと なぞなぞを磨いて\: "I still need more training. I'll polish my riddles even more and beat you next time.
tm.「旅人さん メダル女学園へ ようこそ。\n この学園の メダル校長は\n ちいさ: "Welcome to Medal Academy, traveler. The Academy's Headmaster collects tiny medals.
tm.「もし 校長先生に 用があるのなら\n 校舎の正面玄関から入って\n 目の前に見: "If you want the Headmaster, enter through the school's front entrance. She's in the cottage straight ahead.
tm.「校庭のお花は とってもキレイでしょ？\n とくに かわいらしい スズランの花は: "The flowers in the schoolyard are pretty, right? The cute lilies of the valley are the Headmaster's favorite.
tm.「はかなげに咲く 白い花が\n どことなく ちいさなメダルを\n 思わせるんです: "The delicate white flowers somehow remind her of tiny medals, she says.
tm.「……あ そうそう 旅人さん。\n 小さく はかなげに見えるからって\n スズラ: "...Oh, and traveler. Don't underestimate lilies of the valley just because they look small and fragile.
tm.「スズランの花には 強い毒があるの。\n 間違って 食べてしまったら\n 命にか: "Lilies of the valley are strongly poisonous. If you eat one by mistake, it can threaten your life.
tm.「メダ女に入学した生徒は\n 小さな子も 大きな子も関係なく\n 卒業するまでの: "Students who enter the Academy, small or big, spend seven years in the dorms until graduation.
tm.「ちなみに 私は 今年で５年生。\n 入学したばかりの頃は お家に帰りたくて\n: "I'm in my fifth year this year. When I first enrolled, I wanted to go home and cried every day.
tm.「ナターシャの持ってるツボは スゴイのよ。\n 中に入っている水を 辺りに まい: "The jar Natasha has is amazing. When she sprinkled the water inside around, wilted flowers perked up right away.
tm.「校長先生が大好きな スズランの花も\n ナターシャの おかげで\n 前より ず: "Thanks to Natasha, even the Headmaster's beloved lilies of the valley bloom prettier than before.
tm.「花だんの お花が とってもキレイでしょ？\n とくに かわいらしい スズランの: "The flowers in the flower bed are pretty, right? The cute lilies of the valley are the Headmaster's favorite.
tm.「ナターシャの持ってるツボは スゴイのよ。\n 中に入っている水を 花だんに ま: "The jar Natasha has is amazing. When she sprinkled the water inside on the flower bed, wilted flowers perked up right away.
tm.「わたくしたちは ステキなレディ部！\n 世界一のステキなレディに なるために\: "We are the Lovely Lady Club! A club that carries out all kinds of training to become the loveliest lady in the world!
tm.「この ちいさなメダルを優雅に拾う体操は\n 開校当時から 続けられている\n: "This gymnastics of gracefully picking up tiny medals has continued since the school opened. It's traditional and refined!
